exposure: Biotin, pantothenic acid, and lipoic acid treatment
cohort: The study participants include 16 individuals from eight families, all presenting with phenotypes ranging from multisystem metabolic disorder to peripheral motor neuropathy due to pathogenic biallelic SLC5A6 variants.
finding: Pathogenic biallelic SLC5A6 variants cause a range of clinical phenotypes, which can be diagnosed by genome sequencing, and targeted treatment with biotin, pantothenic acid, and lipoic acid can lead to clinical improvement and substantial cost savings.
